scientific_role: fresh real-system validation of calibration-only selective Layer-B promotion after known-truth support

response_blind_selection.selection_basis: README text identifies Wild Turkey among species with increasing occurrence; no response file header or rows used for focal selection

allowed_operations: derive response-independent cell centroids from Latitude/Longitude
verify temporal coverage and split support
derive four local-world distance thresholds by frozen pairwise-distance quantile rule

geometry_rule.coordinate: mean Latitude/Longitude across survey rows within cell_id using only BBS_surveys.csv

candidate_models.augmented: same learner and baseline predictors plus source-symmetric sequential Layer-B contextual representation
candidate_models.layer_b_generation: for year t, use only focal-taxon positive cell-years with year < t; no same-year or future response

selective_promotion_rule.inner_train: fit baseline and augmented arms using 1980-2009 only
selective_promotion_rule.promotion: promote augmented only if inner-validation macro binary log loss is strictly lower than baseline; otherwise retain baseline
selective_promotion_rule.refit_after_selection: refit selected arm on 1980-2015 calibration period under the same frozen specification

forbidden_after_response_access: change geometry thresholds or their quantile algorithm
change learner family or hyperparameters to rescue outcome
rerun outer heldout after terminal scoring
